name: Apache Airflow job: Build data pipelines powered by Apache Airflow
description: The Apache Airflow job in Microsoft Fabric is now generally available, providing a fully integrated Apache Airflow runtime for developing, scheduling, and monitoring Python-based data workflows using Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).What's New:•	Introducing Fabric runtime versioning for Apache Airflow job – This includes Fabric runtime version 1.0, which comes with Apache Airflow 2.10.4 and Python 3 as the default runtime.•	Public API – APIs are now available to interact with Apache Airflow jobs for seamless management.•	Git Integration & Deployment Pipeline support – Users can utilize their Git repositories (Azure DevOps/GitHub) and deploy with Fabric’s built-in CI/CD workflows.•	Diagnostic logs – Users can access Apache Airflow generated logs through the Apache Airflow job UI for enhanced observability.

result.nameEs: Apache Airflow job: pipelines de datos basados en Apache Airflow
